name: GPT Home
description: Do-it-yourself smart speaker for Raspberry Pi: a voice assistant that controls music, lights, alarms and calendars through an LLM.
whatItDoes: Turns a Raspberry Pi with a microphone and speaker into a home assistant that answers questions and operates connected services. It suits makers who want an open alternative to commercial smart speakers.
howItWorks: A Python application handles wake and speech, routes requests through LiteLLM to a chosen model and uses a LangGraph agent with tools for Spotify, Philips Hue, weather, alarms and CalDAV. A setup script prepares the Pi and the services run in Docker containers with a web interface for settings.

requirements.name: Raspberry Pi with mic and speaker
LITELLM_API_KEY
requirements.description: Key for the model provider used through LiteLLM

run: docker compose down && docker compose up -d
